name: Signeasy
summary: E-signature and contract management for SMBs — unlimited signing and sending, templates, audit trails and integrations, priced per seat.
best_for: small teams that want straightforward unlimited sending and signing per seat, with contract management one tier up
skip_if: you only sign occasional documents, or you are a solo sender at volume — Personal is single-seat and sending-limited
honest_knock: The $10 Personal plan is annual-billed and single-seat — and note that sign-unlimited is not send-unlimited: proper unlimited sending starts at Business, $20 per seat on a yearly commitment, while contract-management features gate at Business Pro, $30 per seat.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed yearly ($120/yr), single seat
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-04 on signeasy.com/pricing, including the page's own pricing script) No free plan, a 14-day free trial and a 100-day money-back guarantee. Three per-seat eSignature tiers: Personal $15 a month billed monthly or $10 billed yearly ($120), single seat, 5 documents sent for signature a month and no templates; Business $30 or $20 a seat ($240), unlimited sending under a fair-usage note and 5 templates; Business Pro $40 or $30 a seat ($360), with roles, permissions and unlimited templates. The yearly toggle says “Save up to 33%”. The script prices other currencies directly rather than converting: yearly per seat a month that is €8, €14 and €24, £7, £12 and £22, or C$12, C$27 and C$39. A fourth tier, Build Your Plan, is custom-priced for 5+ seats or high volume. New since September is a separate Intelligent Contract Management tab: ICM Core $45 and ICM Pro $60 a month per seat, each with a minimum of 3 seats and a Request Demo button rather than a checkout. Signature APIs sit on their own tab: a free sandbox for 100 requests, Intermediate $125 a month ($1,499 billed annually) for 1,000 and Advanced $250 ($2,999) for 2,000.

cost_traps.label: Per-seat pricing
cost_traps.evidence: Three per-seat eSignature tiers: Personal $15 a month billed monthly or $10 billed yearly ($120), single seat, 5 documents sent for signature a month and no templates; Business $30 or $20 a seat ($240), unlimited sending under a fair-usage note and 5 templates; Business Pro $40 or $30 a seat ($360), with roles, permissions and unlimited templates.

compare_with.name: DocuSign
compare_with.why: DocuSign is the enterprise default with the deepest integration catalog; Signeasy is the simpler, cheaper-per-seat alternative for SMB sending and signing
